Chevening Scholarships for Ghana

Chevening Scholarships are fully-funded scholarships to undertake any eligible master's degree at any UK university. The scholarship includes tuition fees, a monthly living allowance, an economy class return airfare to the UK, and additional grants.

Eligibility

To be eligible for a Chevening Scholarship you must be a citizen of a Chevening-eligible country or territory, including Ghana. Ghanaian applicants are encouraged to apply.

You must have an undergraduate degree that will enable you to gain entry onto a postgraduate programme at a UK university. This is typically equivalent to an upper second-class 2:1 honours degree in the UK but may be a lower second-class 2:2 depending on the course and university you choose.

You must have at least two years (2,800 hours) of work experience.

Deadline

Applications close on 4 November 2025 at 12:00 GMT.
